At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work.

That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.

Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!
Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.
Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.
Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.
Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

Earnings: This is an hourly pay + commission role. All US sales reps earn minimum wage (this is permanent, not a draw against commission) in addition to sales commissions, based on your monthly sales. On-target-earnings are estimated between $55,000 - $100K your first year. In addition to the above, we offer fully paid training.
Tribe Sales Training: We have a battle-tested training and tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including sales training through our learning platform, Rippling, Salesforce, Vonage, Google Workspace, and Slack, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.
Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.
Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success. Check our team success stories here !

Hard-working and highly driven individuals who embody Tribe's core values.
Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.
Experience in sales is an advantage, but with our comprehensive tool kit, we welcome those hungry to learn and grow.
A self-starter, motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.
Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.
You'll need a stable internet connection capable of supporting seamless voice and video communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater ( https://chromium.github.io/octane/ ).
A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a working headset.
The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.
Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Take the shot today and work with a very different type of company.

At Curriculum Associates , we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students.

For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs.

Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

The Associate Educational Sales Consultant (AESC) is a client-facing role that partners with the territory team to support sales efforts, build strong district relationships, and contribute to growth within the assigned territory.

The AESC will build interdependent relationships with district-level school administrators to promote digital and print-based products and services within the Curriculum Associates portfolio.

The AESC is a product expert focused on driving and supporting teaching and learning innovation, and partnering with institutions to meet the educational outcomes of access, achievement and affordability to make classrooms a better place for all children. The impact you'll have:
Working with the Director of Sales and Educational Sales Consultants in the Region, gain an understanding of the company’s products, the issues faced by teachers in the classroom and the latest educational trends at the local, state and national level
Assist in identifying new sales opportunities, expansion opportunities, and areas for deeper partnership within assigned accounts.
Establish relationships with school district leaders in targeted accounts
Develop relationships with pilot teachers and ensure smooth implementations
Work with district administrators on launching and maintaining successful engagement campaigns
Under the guidance of the Director of Sales, deliver sales presentations
Participate in district visits, conferences, webinars, and other customer-facing events to increase awareness and engagement. Work to develop effective relationships with internal stakeholders to include Sales, Service, Account Management, and Product Development teams
Learn to develop and implement sales plans & strategies to effectively utilize multiple resources
Communicate with colleagues and cross-functional partners by maintaining accurate and timely updates on account activity, opportunities, customer interactions, and next steps. Gather competitive intelligence and share market feedback to help inform territory strategies. What we're looking for:
Ability to demonstrate digital/technology solutions
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
0-2 years of sales experience; educational and/or SaaS-based sales a plus
Knowledge of MS Office Suite, web-based presentation tools, sales contact management systems (SalesForce.com) a plus

Bei NETSHAKE bekommst du die Bühne, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, groß zu denken und deine Performance in echten Umsatz zu übersetzen. Kein Mittelmaß. Keine Limits. Nur Wachstum – für unsere Kunden und für dich.

Aufgaben 🔹 Opening & Kaltakquise – Du gehst aktiv in die Neukundenansprache, identifizierst Potenziale und eröffnest qualifizierte Opportunities.

Systematisch. Hartnäckig.

Abschlussorientiert. 🔹 Pipeline-Ownership – Saubere CRM-Dokumentation, KPI-Fokus und volle Transparenz über deine Zahlen. 🔹 Angebotsstrategie – Du erstellst individuelle, performance-orientierte Angebote mit klarem Mehrwert. 🔹 Prozess-Optimierung – Du denkst Sales unternehmerisch weiter und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge aktiv ein.

Qualifikation ✔️ Unternehmermindset – Du denkst in Umsatz, Chancen und Lösungen.

Ownership statt Ausreden ist für dich selbstverständlich. ✔️ Hunter-Mentalität im Vertrieb – Du liebst Closing, beherrschst moderne Verkaufstechniken und willst gewinnen – nicht nur teilnehmen. ✔️ Volle Eigenverantwortung – Du organisierst dich selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und lieferst Ergebnisse. ✔️ Performance-Drive – Herausforderungen triggern dich.

Du willst besser werden, schneller werden, größer denken. ✔️ Ziel- & Abschlussorientierung – KPIs sind für dich kein Druck, sondern Motivation.

Erfolge feierst du – aber erst nach dem Deal. ✔️ Wachstums-Mentalität – Du investierst in deine Weiterentwicklung und willst vom Setter zum Closer wachsen. ✔️ Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse – Verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits ✨ Attraktive Vergütung – Starkes Fixgehalt plus Bonusmodell. ✨ Sales Excellence – Exklusive Trainings mit Europas Top-Sales-Experten. Wir formen Performer, keine Verwalter. ✨ Shopify Academy – Tiefes Produkt- und Marktverständnis.

Dein Wissensvorsprung im E-Commerce-Game. ✨ Karriere mit Geschwindigkeit – Klare Wachstumsstruktur, schnelle Entwicklung, echte Aufstiegschancen für Hunter mit Drive. ✨ High-Performance-Umfeld – Systeme, KPIs und Prozesse, die dir den Rücken freihalten.

Fokus auf Closing, nicht auf Chaos. ✨ Maximale Flexibilität – Remote von überall oder Energie tanken in unserem stylischen Office in Bay Square, Business Bay, Dubai. ✨ Persönliche Entwicklung – jeden Tag – Ownership, Verantwortung, Wachstum. Komfortzone ist kein Bestandteil unseres Modells. ✨ Teamevents mit Energie – Gewinner feiern gemeinsam.

Wir suchen keine Bewerber. Wir suchen Hunter. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn du in einem professionellen Umfeld wachsen und Leistung bringen willst – komm ins Gewinnerteam! Originally posted on Himalayas

About Peec AI
Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.
We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

We’re looking for a Visiting Sales Associate to support our sales and revenue teams as we scale Peec AI’s global customer base. In this role, you’ll work closely with the sales team on deal execution, sales content, and CRM operations while helping improve the systems and automations that power our revenue engine.

You’ll gain hands-on exposure to modern B2B SaaS sales, from outreach and pipeline management to revenue operations and automation, making this an ideal role for someone eager to learn quickly and contribute to a fast-growing startup’s go-to-market efforts.

Support the sales team in closing deals and managing key client relationships
Develop sales content - from outreach sequences to pitch decks and case studies
Design and implement automations across our sales stack to improve efficiency and tracking
Contribute to revenue operations by analyzing metrics, improving CRM hygiene, and streamlining data flows
Jump into new challenges, learn fast, and help make things happen

Currently pursuing or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong academic performance
2+ internships in sales, top-tier startups, venture capital, management consulting, or investment banking
Self-starter with a bias for action, eager to learn, and comfortable with ambiguity
Analytical mindset and structured approach to problem-solving, allowing you to take ownership from day 1
Solid grasp of technology and excitement to work hands-on with cutting-edge AI and automation tools
Low-ego team player who’s easy to work with and doesn’t shy away from rolling up their sleeves for operational tasks

Experience with tools like HubSpot, Clay, Lemlist, Apollo, Notion, or n8n

Have built your own startup or cool projects you’re proud of

s.h: As an SDR, your role will include
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Identify and research high-growth organizations—from AI startups to Fortune 500 enterprises—that are struggling with Kubernetes scalability and infrastructure costs.
Technical Outreach: Craft highly personalized, technical outreach that cuts through the noise. You won’t be using "fluff"; you’ll be engaging engineers with value-driven narratives about virtualization and resource efficiency.
Pipeline Architecture: Own the top-of-funnel engine, converting inbound interest and outbound leads into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.
Multi-Channel Mastery: Orchestrate a modern sequence of touchpoints across LinkedIn, email, and phone, while engaging authentically in developer-centric spaces.
Market Intelligence: Act as a critical feedback loop for Product and Marketing by capturing the "voice of the prospect" and identifying emerging pain points in the AI and MLOps landscape.
Process Innovation: Partner with Sales Ops to constantly refine our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay) and experiment with new ways to automate the mundane so you can focus on the meaningful.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or a high-intensity customer-facing role, preferably within the DevOps, Cloud, or SaaS space.
Technical Curiosity: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be "K8s-curious." You are excited to learn the difference between a pod and a virtual cluster so you can speak with authority.
Grit & Ownership: You thrive in an early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written. You take extreme ownership of your targets and drive outcomes without needing a script.
Communication Clarity: You have a gift for distilling complex infrastructure concepts into clear, high-impact messages that spark curiosity in highly technical buyers.
AI-Native Workflow: You naturally use AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and streamline your daily workflow to stay ahead of the curve.
Cognitive Flexibility: You view "no" as data. You are quick to pivot your strategy based on feedback and market signals.

Ecosystem Familiarity: Prior exposure to the CNCF landscape, Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), or the AI/ML stack.

Founding Mentality: A desire to grow into a closer (AE) or a leadership role as we scale through our next phase of growth.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Platinum-Level Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for
s.t:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.
A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.
Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.
Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.
Strong written communication.
Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.
Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.
Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.
Helpful, not required
Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.
Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.
Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.
How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.
What Success Looks Like
Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

Ce soutien comprendra la qualification et l’évolution des premiers contacts, la préparation de devis budgétaires, le suivi des prospects potentiels jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient prêts pour la vente, ainsi que des tâches administratives afin d’assurer des processus d’affaires fluides et efficaces.

Entretenir des relations à long terme avec les clients existants et acquérir de nouveaux clients, notamment dans les principaux domaines de caractérisation des particules (diffraction laser, diffusion dynamique de la lumière, analyse d’image, microcalorimétrie, XRF, XRD, NIR, services d’analyses).
Fournir un soutien à l’équipe Inside Sales EMEA selon les besoins, tout en respectant les indicateurs de performance établis.

Vous êtes une personne dotée d’un fort sens commercial, avec un haut niveau de réactivité et prête à aller au-delà des attentes.
Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences en communication orale, en écoute et en questionnement, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension de nos produits et de leur utilisation dans des environnements industriels et académiques.
A un impact sur la croissance des activités de Malvern Panalytical au niveau régional. Contribue à l’image professionnelle de Malvern Panalytical .
A un impact sur la satisfaction client.

Vous détenez un baccalauréat en sciences (B. Sc.) ou un diplôme supérieur, ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience en biologie générale, biochimie, chimie, physique, génie chimique ou science des matériaux.
Deux à quatre années d’expérience pertinente en ventes/applications et/ou formation.
La maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit, oral et compréhension) est essentielle pour ce rôle, le gestionnaire étant basé aux États-Unis et le poste impliquant des interactions avec des clients potentiels à travers le Canada ainsi qu’avec des collègues situés dans différentes régions du monde.
Compétences et aptitudes
Motivation personnelle et ambition d’évoluer dans le poste ; expérience en vente technique / services analytiques / organismes de recherche sous contrat (une expérience dans les sciences de la vie / l’industrie pharmaceutique est un atout).
Capacité à discuter et à vendre des services.
Votre carrière démarrera avec un programme d’intégration complet. Nous continuons ensuite à soutenir et à développer nos employés en améliorant leurs compétences, leurs connaissances et leur performance grâce à des formations internes, en situation de travail, et externes.
Nous valorisons l’esprit d’initiative et l’engagement en offrant de réelles opportunités de carrière.

Nous offrons un programme de rémunération concurrentiel. Nos avantages comprennent une assurance médicale, dentaire, de la vue et d’invalidité, un REER collectif avec participation de l’employeur, accès à la télémédecine ainsi qu’à un programme d’aide aux employés (PAE).

s.h: About us - Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics and SciAps.
s.t:
Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.
We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.
Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.
Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.
SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.
We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.
We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Precision is at the heart of what we do – our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.
Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics & SciAps
Your Partners in Discovery
Malvern Panalytical , Micromeritics and SciAps, part of the Spectris Group, are committed to a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive and achieve a fulfilling career.

Consistently deliver against sales goals, call activity expectations, and launch milestones.
Maintain accurate territory reporting, and CRM documentation

Apply strong business acumen to assess market dynamics and leverage insights for effective territory planning.
Build and sustain trusted relationships with healthcare providers, office staff, and key decision-makers
Clearly and compliantly communicate clinical data, product value, access information, and appropriate patient identification.
Deliver engaging, high-quality product presentations and address customers questions with confidence and credibility.
Partner with customers to address barriers to patient access and support product pull-through
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to understand customers needs and elevate the overall customer and patient experience in a compliant manner.
Collaborate closely with adjacent field partners including Field Reimbursement Managers, Territory Managers, and Regional Business Directors to support customer needs and territory objectives
Share insights, learnings, and best practices with field leadership and internal team (e.g., Marketing, Training, Field Operations and Analytics)

Support regional meetings, launch initiatives, and company-sponsored programs
